title: 09 — Zosia / pierwsza seria
description: Zosia strzela w prawo, ku tarasowi. Widoczna końcówka lufy z błyskiem, łuska i praca barku pod odrzutem. Bliźniaki poza osią strzału po lewej stronie salonu. Widoczny zakres źródła: 0–2 s, 24 fps, 1080×1920. Gotowe kadry; animacja do wygenerowania. Natywne audio wyłączone, dialog i SFX osobno.

prompts.image: Edit this exact image as a powerful action-film still, vertical9:16. Preserve exact woman's facial likeness, black hair with blue strands, black printed oversized metal shirt, jewellery, black jeans, exact Polish living room and hallway. Reframe slightly wider and move subject to left so ENTIRE rifle muzzle is visible with clear space at screen right. Same classic black M16 carry handle fixed stock straight magazine, two correct hands. She is firing toward SCREEN RIGHT, grounded stance leaning into recoil, focused unflinching face. Compact bright orange-white muzzle flash emerges ONLY from barrel tip, small reflected warm light on hand and face, ONE brass casing caught just right of receiver, slight smoke from muzzle. Weapon butt firmly at shoulder, barrel stays pointed right. Subtle motion in hair tips and sleeves, face sharp. No extra fingers, no extra guns, no giant fireball, no text or watermark. Single still no panels.
prompts.animation: 0.0–0.65s: Zosia fires a short burst toward screen right; the stock stays against her shoulder as her arms absorb tight recoil pulses. 0.65–1.0s: her aim shifts a few degrees right. 1.0–1.7s: a second short burst repeats the recoil. 1.7–3.0s: she tracks the next target with small continuous aim corrections and breathing. Camera: short lateral track on the same side of the firing axis. Secondary: brief flashes originate only at the muzzle tip; individual brass cases eject and fall. @Image1 preserves Zosia; @Image2 preserves the rifle. Preserve face, printed shirt, hands and rifle shape. No smoke cloud behind her head, receiver flashes, sustained flame, slow motion or cut.
